venue.name: British Columbia Aviation Museum
venue.description: The British Columbia Aviation Museum at 1910 Norseman Road on Victoria International Airport property in North Saanich collects and displays aircraft and artifacts documenting the aviation history of Vancouver Island, British Columbia and Canada, including the Hawaii Martin Mars waterbomber. It runs curriculum-linked education programs for classes from preschool to secondary, guided tours for all ages, a children's play area and birthday parties.
venue.hours_notes: Open 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM, 7 days a week, September to June; 9:30 AM to 4:30 PM, July to August. Closed December 25, December 26 and January 1. No administrative staff available between December 25 and January 2.
venue.seasonal_notes: Access to the inside of the Hawaii Mars is weather dependent to ensure the safety of visitors. Education program time slots are 10am-12pm (morning) and 12:30pm-2:30pm (afternoon).
venue.price_year_or_season: 2025-2026 school year (education programs page states it welcomes classrooms for the 2025-2026 school year); general admission prices are undated

programs.name: Hands-On Flying with Models
programs.description: Immersive hands-on program for preschool to Grade 1. Students are introduced to selected Museum displays and challenged to work out how an airplane is able to fly, then each build a glider and experiment with properties that influence flight. Curriculum takeaways are that the motion of objects depends on their properties and that matter is useful because of its properties. $8.50 per student with no charge for adult supervisors, who must supervise the group. Offered in a 10am-12pm or 12:30pm-2:30pm time slot. Invoiced before the visit, payment due on the day; cancellations must be made at least 72 hours ahead or a 50% cancellation fee applies, and reschedules need at least one week's notice.
programs.evidence: Hands-On Flying with Models (Preschool to Grade 1):

programs.name: The Science of Flight - Bernoulli's Principals
programs.description: Program for Grades 6/7 exploring how flight is possible in a world of gravity. Students are introduced to Bernoulli's Principal, study balanced and unbalanced forces, conduct an experiment to see the principle in action, then use Museum displays to reinforce what they discovered. $8.50 per student with no charge for adult supervisors. Offered in a 10am-12pm or 12:30pm-2:30pm time slot.
programs.evidence: Pricing for these types of visits is set at $8.50 per student, with no charge for adult supervisors.

programs.name: The History of the Commonwealth Air Training Program
programs.description: Program for Grades 11/12 on Canada's contribution to World War 2 through the Commonwealth Air Training Plan, its role before, during and after the war, and its effect on the economic and political life of Canadians. Students view selected Museum displays, answer questions about the Plan and debate their responses with peers. $8.50 per student with no charge for adult supervisors. Offered in a 10am-12pm or 12:30pm-2:30pm time slot.
programs.evidence: Pricing for these types of visits is set at $8.50 per student, with no charge for adult supervisors.

programs.name: Guided Tour
programs.description: Guided tour of the museum led by a specially trained Museum Guide, offered for all ages. Students explore the exhibits and learn about the history of aviation in British Columbia and Canada, and can walk through selected aircraft, from sitting in the pilot's seat of a Lockheed T-33 fighter jet to walking through the Hawaii Mars waterbomber. Booked by email. The page does not state a separate price for the guided tour on its own.
programs.evidence: That’s not all! The museum offers guided tours for all ages.

programs.name: Prebooked Adult Group Admission (10 or more)
programs.description: Discounted self-guided museum admission for prebooked adult groups of 10 or more, at $15.00 plus GST per adult instead of the regular $20.00 plus GST. Listed in the admission table on the museum home page; no equivalent prebooked group rate for children is published there.
programs.evidence: Adult Group (10 or more prebooked) $15.00 + GST

gaps: Booking email addresses on bcam.net are hidden behind Cloudflare email protection and could not be read, so booking_email is null. The education programs page says all bookings are made by email; the phone number 250-655-3300 is published in the site footer.
No maximum capacity or minimum group size is stated for any education program.
No minimum booking lead time is stated. The page states only that cancellations must be made at least 72 hours ahead (50% fee inside that window) and that reschedules need at least one week's notice.
Washrooms are not mentioned anywhere on the site.

No lunch space or picnic area is stated for school groups. The Norseman Room with tables, chairs and kitchen access is described only for birthday parties, and the education page asks groups to wait in the front garden if weather allows because the entry area cannot accommodate large groups.
Rain backup is not stated. The exhibits are in a hangar but the site notes that access to the inside of the Hawaii Mars is weather dependent.
Stroller access is not mentioned. The General Information page states only 'We are wheelchair accessible.'

Bus parking is recorded as true on the basis of 'Oversized vehicles are permitted in our Additional Parking Lot area only' plus 'Free parking located on premises'; the site never uses the words bus or coach.

No youngest age is stated. Programs start at preschool and children 5 and under are free with an adult family member, but no minimum age is given. General Information states children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult.
There are no education programs listed for Grades 2-5 or Grades 8-10; the page invites teachers to email for other classroom needs.
The Guided Tour for all ages has no published price, duration or capacity, and it is not stated whether the $8.50 per student education rate covers it.
Birthday parties are offered in the Norseman Room but no price, duration, age range or capacity is published on the birthday parties page.
Whether the $8.50 per student education price includes GST is not stated; general admission prices are all quoted as plus GST.
